name: Nesting depth
description: Flags functions/events whose If/While nesting depth exceeds a configurable threshold.
definition: Flags functions/events whose control-flow nesting depth (1 per nested `If`/`ElseIf`/`While`; `Else` does not add a level; a surrounding `State` is ignored) reaches a configurable threshold, as `[info]` at `nesting_depth_info` (default 4), `[warning]` at `nesting_depth_warning` (default 6), or `[error]` at `nesting_depth_error` (default 9). A configured warning below info is treated as equal to info, and a configured error below warning is treated as equal to warning.
